**Format sample: multiple correct.** Which of these are vector quantities? Select the two that apply.
solution:
Force and velocity have both magnitude and direction. Mass, temperature and energy are scalars.

On the exam a multiple-correct item is scored right only when every selection is right.

stem: **Format sample: drag and drop, match.** Place each SI unit on the quantity it measures. One unit is not used.
solution: Stress is force per area (Pa), energy is in joules (J) and power is in watts (W). The newton (N) measures force and stays unused.
